name: Three takes and the best one
about: One scene with three seeds: shoot them all, pick the best — it goes into the join.

data.title: Scene
data.text:
Realistic live-action cinematic look, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, film grain.

Scene: a quiet seaside pier at dawn; an adult woman, about 30, with long dark hair, in a beige coat, walks toward the camera.

Camera: medium shot, slow push-in.

Timeline:
[0s-3s] She walks along the pier toward the camera.
[3s-5s] She stops and looks at the sea.

Audio: waves, seagulls, soft wind.

No text, subtitles, logos or watermarks.

Three takes and the best one.

The scene has three seeds. «Shoot up to here» shoots the chosen one; switch takes in the scene's panel and shoot each — they all go into the cache, the chosen one goes into the join. «Another take» adds a fourth, «Clean up takes» removes the ones not chosen.
